question.problem:
Let $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}}$ be a basis of ${R}^{3}.$ The matrix $[\,T\,]_{B}$ of the linear transformation $T:{R}^{3}\to {R}^{3}$ is given by

$$
[\,T\,]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}a & 1 & 2 \\ -1 & b & -2 \\ 3 & 0 & c\end{aligned}].
$$

Find the value of $\,a+b+c,\,$ given that 

$$
\begin{aligned}T({b}_{1}) & =2{b}_{1}-{b}_{2}+3{b}_{3}, \\ T({b}_{2}) & ={b}_{1}+3{b}_{2}, \\ T({b}_{3}) & =2{b}_{1}-2{b}_{2}+3{b}_{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
First, we write down the coordinates of the images relative to the basis $B:$

$$
[T({b}_{1})]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,[T({b}_{2})]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,[T({b}_{3})]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -2 \\ 3\end{aligned}]
$$

Now, the $B$-matrix for $T$ is a matrix  whose columns are the coordinates of the vectors $T({b}_{1}),$ $T({b}_{2}),$ and $T({b}_{3})$ relative to the basis $B.$ Therefore, we obtain

$$
[\,T\,]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 & 2 \\ -1 & 3 & -2 \\ 3 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, $a=2,$ $b=3,$ $c=3$ and 

$$
a+b+c=2+3+3=8.
$$
